headline: Near highs, strong Buy consensus, limited near-term upside
chart_note: 52-week range: $110.39 - $176.41. Currently $166.72, about 5.5% below its high, up roughly 55% over the past year.
why_today: ExxonMobil is trading close to its 52-week high after a roughly 55% run over the past year, with a strong Buy-leaning consensus across 25 analysts. The average price target implies only about 4% further upside from here - most of the recent good news already looks priced in.
pro_1: 43 consecutive years of dividend increases plus a solid 2.5% yield - a genuine quality signal for an energy major
pro_2: Analyst consensus is firmly Buy, and PE of 21.4x is reasonable given the stock's strong recent performance
con_1: Average price target implies only about 4% upside - limited near-term reward at current levels
con_2: Trading near 52-week highs after a big 12-month run means less margin of safety if oil prices roll over
